findings.finding: Independent reviewer PASS was incorrectly treated as if Founder QC had passed.
Founder authorization to proceed was incorrectly recorded as product-specific publication authorization.
Mission Control principal-primary browser profile was used for H03 operational readiness probing.

invariants: Independent review cannot impersonate Founder QC.
Founder QC cannot be inferred from phase authorization.
External publication requires explicit Founder product release authorization.
H03 operational browser pools must be H03-dedicated and cannot reuse Mission Control/Architect/Division01 or other-holding operational profiles.
Foreign-profile readiness observations are invalid for H03 runtime readiness.
